record.summary: The continuous three-phase cycle the whole game runs on. Navigating and breaking (the Macro): chart a course through ice of varying density, trading fuel and prow damage for speed and yield. Scavenging and ingestion (the intake): raw materials ground out of the ice enter the primary cargo hold. Building and automating (the Micro): route materials through refineries, fabricators, and the engine core, building a closed-loop control plane. The loop is a spiral, not a circle: each pass leaves the ship heavier, hungrier, and more capable, and stopping at any point begins the crush-death clock.
record.title: The core gameplay loop: break, ingest, build
